title: Personal Sender Account Terms — Closure and Termination
content:
**Closure by the customer.** Only the customer can close their own Personal Sender Account, and only from status active; a locked, restricted or suspended account cannot be closed at the customer's request until it is active again. The agent explains the effect and the customer confirms the closure themselves.

## Transfers that must be settled

Closure is allowed only when every one of the customer's transfers meets the condition of its delivery method:

| Delivery method | Every transfer must be |
|---|---|
| Bank Deposit | deposited, refunded, or cancelled with nothing left owed back on it |
| Cash Pickup | paid out, refunded, or cancelled with nothing left owed back on it |
| Mobile Wallet | credited, refunded, or cancelled with nothing left owed back on it |

A cancelled transfer has nothing left owed back when the principal held and the fees held on it are both 0.00 USD. Closure while a transfer is open is not allowed at any level, so an open transfer must first finish, or be cancelled and refunded, before closure.

## After closure

Paloma keeps a closed account's records for 5 years, as the Bank Secrecy Act requires, and statements of the retained history remain available. A closed account is never reopened; a customer who closed their own account may apply for a new one.

## Termination

Paloma terminates a suspended account only by a final compliance or fraud decision, and a terminated customer may not apply again.

## Hypothetical cases

- A customer with an active account holds one Cash Pickup transfer ready for pickup. Closure is not allowed until that transfer is paid out, or cancelled and refunded.
- A customer's only Bank Deposit transfer is cancelled, with 0.00 USD principal held and 0.00 USD fees held. That transfer does not stand in the way of closure.
- A customer whose account is restricted asks to close it. Closure at the customer's request waits until the account is active again.
